scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Sal J. Prezioso was a civic leader, educator, and a public servant who actively served in local, state, city of Yonkers, and Westchester County government. He also established Pace University's graduate program in public administration.

This collection documents Prezioso's life, career, and dedication to public service, including his activities as: Director, Employee Relations, Rockefeller Center, 1939-1948; Superintendent of Recreation, Village of Scarsdale, 1948-1955; Superintendent of Westchester County, 1955-1961; Executive Officer, Westchester County, 1962-1967; President, National Recreation and Parks Association, 1967-1970; Commissioner, New York State Parks and Recreation, 1970-1971; Commissioner, New York State Office for Local Government, 1971-1975; Director, Graduate Program in Public Administration, Pace University, 1978-1982; City Manager, Yonkers, 1982-1983; Executive Director, Michaelian Institute for Sub/Urban Governance and Municipal Law, 1984-1985; and Executive Director, Westchester 2000, 1986-2000.
